identity.title: Systematic Variations of CO J = 2-1/1-0 Ratio and Their Implications in The Nearby Barred Spiral Galaxy M83

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present spatial variations of the CO $J$=2-1/1-0 line ratio (${R_{21/10}}$) in the barred spiral galaxy M83 using Total Power array (single dish telescopes) data from the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA).

evidence.quote: the barred spiral galaxy M83 at a distance of 4.5 Mpc (cite: Thim:2003aa)
the barred spiral galaxy M83 at a distance of 4.5 Mpc (cite: Thim:2003aa)

question.value: How does the CO 2-1/1-0 line ratio vary across the disk of M83, and how does it relate to molecular gas surface density, FUV/IR emission and dust temperature?

evidence.quote: While the intensities of these two lines correlate tightly, ${R_{21/10}}$ varies over the disk, with a disk average ratio of 0.69, and shows the galactic center and a two-arm spiral pattern.
